<Subject 2> is Xie Linchuan, the single adult man around thirty in <Picture 1>, preserving his established face, long half-tied black hair, silver crown, white inner robe and blue-gray flowing embroidered outer robe. He uses one straight silver-gray jian with a plain guard; its dark-blue empty scabbard remains at his left hip when the sword is drawn.
<Subject 4> is Lu Xingzhou, the single 18-year-old adult male disciple in <Picture 1>, preserving his youthful face, high black ponytail and narrow silver band, charcoal layers, muted burgundy outer robe, dark belt and boots. He uses one slender straight jian in his right hand; the empty dark scabbard and red tassel remain at his left hip. His revised identity has a short rounded face, fuller cheeks, round-open eyes, gently curved brows, a short nose, fuller lips and an asymmetrical side fringe; retain this distinct young adult face.
<Subject 6> is the snowy practice courtyard surrounding the two men in <Picture 1>: a broad level stone platform with a visible dark rectangular boundary, snow-capped railing, pavilion at the left rear, bamboo entrance to the right, snowy pines and distant mountains in pale afternoon light.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing Lu on the left and Xie on the right, both holding one drawn sword in their anatomical right hands, with their full bodies and the snowy courtyard visible.
<Picture 2> is the final frame of [Shot 1], showing the SAME two men after the exchange, balanced a little closer, anatomical right-hand blades separated in low guards and left hands empty.

Begin from <Picture 1> and finish on <Picture 2>, which establishes two distinct adult identities, right-hand drawn swords, empty left-hip scabbards and the fighting space. This is the first representative combat clip, with a visible attack, defense and result.

detailed_description:
r34l1sm. The target video retains the established semi-realistic Chinese guofeng character style, soft natural skin shading and readable cloth texture, with clear physical swordplay and restrained visual effects.
[Shot 1] Begin from <Picture 1>. Exactly two people remain visible: <Subject 2> and <Subject 4>; zero passersby or extras. A stable eye-level medium-wide full-body shot establishes <Subject 6>. <Subject 4> stands on screen left facing right, while <Subject 2> stands on screen right facing left, about two steps apart. Both are already inside the clearly visible stone boundary, each holding exactly one drawn straight sword in his anatomical right hand. Empty scabbards stay attached at their left hips. Keep both heads, feet, sword tips and the space between them visible throughout the exchange. The woman and other spectators remain outside the frame. Snow rests on the platform, railings and pavilion roof, and fine flakes continue falling without obscuring the fighters.
During the first two seconds, the men briefly acknowledge one another with a small sword salute, then settle into balanced guards. The younger man's eyes are intent, jaw set and weight slightly forward; the older man's gaze is focused and shoulders relaxed. This short preparation immediately leads into actual action rather than becoming a standing pose for the whole clip. Their boots lightly compress the thin snow; fabric follows their weight shifts.
From two to five seconds, the younger man pushes from his back foot, advances one controlled step and extends his right arm in a straight thrust toward the older man's upper-torso line. Show the sword tip traveling from left to right along a continuous readable path. The older man reacts after the thrust begins: he moves a half-step toward the background, away from the direct line, and brings his own right-hand blade diagonally across to meet and redirect the attacking blade outward. The swords make one visible contact in the open space between them, synchronized with a single sharp metal ring. Neither blade passes through a body or changes hands.
From five to eight seconds, the redirected thrust finishes beside the defender rather than inside him. The younger man bends his elbow, retrieves his blade and shifts weight back to regain balance. The older man releases the pressure and returns to a low controlled guard without adding a second attack. A small spray of powder snow follows their foot placement; robe hems and ponytails settle naturally after the movement. The younger man's expression briefly registers surprise, while the older man remains attentive rather than triumphant.
For the final two seconds, both men stand securely about one and a half steps apart, younger man left and older man right, swords separated and held low enough to make the completed exchange clear. Settle into the recovered positions in <Picture 2> and hold them for continuity. The intervening thrust, visible parry contact and recovery must occur before reaching this ending. No spoken lines, slow motion, large magical bursts, blood, extra weapons, body doubling, camera orbit, subtitles or black ending.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous winter wind and distant pine movement, close boot scrapes and snow crunch, cloth movement and one synchronized metal contact. Breathing is restrained; there is no dialogue, narration, chanting or yelling.

non_diegetic_music:
A restrained but energetic instrumental battle motif begins with low drums, clipped pipa notes and rhythmic strings around 96 BPM. Keep a steady pulse under the exchange, briefly leaving sonic space for the blade contact. Avoid vocals and exaggerated heroic swells. Continue the rhythmic phrase into the next combat clip instead of resolving or restarting every ten seconds.
